author: Google
description:
Specific verbs create stronger, specific visuals. ✍️

Our next In the Flow interview features https://www.youtube.com/@Visually_AI sharing her best advice for creating AI films. Thanks https://www.youtube.com/@Visually_AI for the partnership!

🏃‍♀️ For action shots: Use descriptive terms like "gliding" instead of "moving"
🌗 To set the scene: Define the lighting, time of day, and mood
🎨 To fine-tune the visual details: Describe the textures and subtle imperfections, or specific perspectives

Over the coming weeks, we're sharing unique workflows and tips from more creators pushing their boundaries. Make sure to follow so you don't miss the next episode!

Try Flow for yourself: https://flow.google  
Learn how to create in Flow: https://youtu.be/9nVEfjmDlVk?si=DKlab6LdBgjaOCX4 
See our Flow playlist on YouTube: https://youtube.com/playlist?list=PL590L5WQmH8cZy80Ko7dzpH2MyvNJFE-p&si=JziPldokD6tevISg
